params.body:
Closes #429

## What was wrong

"Paste a link" in the Studio (`POST /articles/:id/sources/link`, `packages/core/source-by-link.mjs`) refused every response whose content type was not HTML, XML or plain text with "That link is not a web page". A trend report linked as a PDF could not be cited, so a claim taken from it went out unsourced or was cut.

## What changes

- `fetchPage` accepts a PDF: `application/pdf`, or `application/octet-stream` under a name ending in `.pdf`, or any body that starts with `%PDF-`. Same public-web checks per hop as a page. A PDF is read up to 40 MB and refused above it (a PDF cut short cannot be read, its index sits at the end); a page stays at 2 MB.
- `readPdf` writes the bytes to a temporary folder, reads title, subject, creation date and page count with `pdfinfo` and the text of the first 80 pages with `pdftotext`, each as its own process with a 30 s deadline, and removes the folder. The title comes from the file unless it is a tool name ("Microsoft Word - final_v3.docx", "Untitled"), then the first line on the cover, then the file name.
- The signal comes in under "Cited by the author" like a page, `meta.format = 'pdf'` and `meta.pages` added. Up to 60,000 characters of text are kept (a page keeps 3,000): classify and enrich read only the first 300, and the review gate snapshots the whole text, so a claim from page 20 can be retraced.
- Refusals in the writer's words: "That link is not a web page or a PDF", "That link said PDF but gave something else" (a login page served as PDF), "That PDF is larger than 40 MB", "The PDF has no text to read; it may be scanned pages", "The PDF could not be read".
- `binaries.mjs`: `pdfinfo` and `pdftotext` name `source-by-link.mjs` as a caller. Both are already required on the box and installed in CI.

No Studio change: it shows the server's message as it is.

## Checked

- `test/source-by-link.test.mjs`: six new cases on a real PDF built in the test (title, subject, date and text into a raw signal under its sentence; octet-stream; tool-name title falls back to the cover; neither page nor PDF; fake PDF; no text; empty title field; tool failure).
- On real files from the workbench: arXiv 1706.03762 (2.2 MB, 15 pages, 39,621 characters) and a one-page W3C test PDF read; a web page still reads as before.
- Full suite 1609/1609, `tsc` clean.

After merge nothing is to be run on the box; the Studio picks it up on deploy.
params.title: Cite a PDF by its link in the Studio, not only a web page
